notes: 10.20.0.31 is the only IP the dataset calls allowlisted ('approved scanner, exact allowlist match'). Case 11 states it explicitly: 'The approved scanner allowlist contains 10.20.0.31 only.' Adding further entries would contradict the eval dataset.

10.44.2.17 (case 02), 203.0.113.77 (case 03) and the source hosts implied by other cases are ordinary alert sources, not allowlisted scanners.
